comparison.objective: Place a book on a stand, open it, and turn a marked page; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual book placement and hinged page manipulation versus screw/nut countertorque and tool regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Released spine registered, cover and page opened at least 150° versus locked opening accuracy and cycle retention.
comparison.reason: The articulated objects and success outcomes are not equivalent.
